messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can someone clarify the APAC GPU capacity plan and how autoscaling will behave during spot churn? High-level is fine, want something I can forward to customers.

mike: Sure — short version: APAC is a phased ramp. We're bringing up HK first (smaller footprint to validate), then SIN. Procurement + cloud region supply windows determine exact cadence. :wave:

josh: Timeline note: HK target is end of Q3 for initial pools, SIN target Q4 for wider capacity. We'll publish a public timeline doc next week.

aria: Autoscaler behavior basics: production routes prefer on-demand for steady SLA workloads. Spot/interruptible pools used for burst capacity and cheaper Dedicated burst tiers. If spot preemption rate exceeds our threshold we automatically fallback to on-demand for affected shards.

aria: Example of the runtime policy we're testing (dev shorthand):
```
policy:
  spot_preempt_threshold: 0.15  # if >15% preempt in 5m window
  fallback: on_demand
  cooldown_seconds: 300
```

mike: To add — fallback is per-region, per-pool, and per-customer tier. We won't failover Dedicated customers to a different region without an explicit config flag from the customer.

nina: For product QA: will we expose a flag in the Console to opt-in to cross-region fallback? Some PMs asked about that for latency-sensitive workloads.

mike: Not by default. We will expose it as an opt-in toggle for customers who want geo-fallback. Default for Hosted + Dedicated is same-region only.

sri: Where will folks monitor spot churn / preemption metrics?

josh: Console -> Operations -> Region health. Also we stream region-preempt events to #eng-infra and emit an alert when preempt rate spikes above 10% for >10m. Link to UI: https://console.redwood.dev/ops/regions (internal only).

sri: Thanks — can you add a quick how-to in the readme for on-call?

josh: Will do. I'll add runbook steps and the alert thresholds.

aria: On the model side — Redwood Optimize will start surfacing per-model autoscale hints (batch sizes, preferred quant/profile) in the next release (beta). That should help customers reduce reliance on big spot bursts.

elaine: Are there any hard constraints customers should know before future-sales calls? e.g., minimum lead time for Dedicated on APAC?

mike: For Dedicated reserved capacity in APAC we'll ask for ~8–12 weeks lead time initially (procurement + quota). We'll tighten that as we have standing capacity.

nina: Action items: Mike to post concise FAQ + timeline doc; Josh to update runbook and console links; Aria to share Optimize beta notes.

mike: Yep — I’ll post the FAQ in #product and drop a link into the all-hands thread by Monday.

recording-bot: Recording uploaded: https://drive.redwood.dev/all-hands/1872001234 (auto); timestamped notes attached.

elaine: Great, thanks team :thumbsup:
